fit.subtitle: The 482/186 pathway suits some situations and not others. Here's a direct assessment, no jargon.

yes.title: This pathway suits you if...
items: You have at least 1 year of paid, full-time work experience in a skilled occupation
Your occupation is on the MLTSSL or STSOL - ICT and Marketing roles typically qualify
You are working towards or already want Permanent Residency
You do not yet have employer sponsorship but want to find it
You are willing to commit to working with a single employer for at least 2 years for the 186 TRT pathway

no.title: This may not suit you if...
items: You have less than 1 year of relevant work experience - in that case, our Career Launch Program is the right first step
Your occupation is not currently on an eligible skilled occupation list
You have had a previous visa refused and haven't yet received legal advice about its impact
You need a solution in under 3 months - consider our Emergency Solutions instead
